updates.rationale: A code-structure converse is a credible but nonautomatic direction in the preexisting research landscape. If pursued, this program-level allocation covers independent formulation, decomposition of the converse agenda, and coordination of rigorous proof and computational work packages.

Conditional on opening the program, researchers have a substantial chance of testing receiver-conditioned dependence and channel-specific refinements. Independent discovery requires deriving a finite-block relation, controlling its asymptotic passage, separating channel-realizable laws from abstract entropy models, and rigorously checking counterexamples and auxiliary constructions.

Exploratory work remains likely within the program because the relevant converse route is unresolved and standard entropy relaxations can be misleading. The allocation covers independent numerical experimentation, failed inequality searches, construction and verification of finite witnesses, and attempts to identify usable channel-specific restrictions.
